feeds.title: Simple art craft
feeds.description: I am Priyadarshini Ramakrishnan, a genetic researcher turned crafter and graphic designer. Blog posts cover articles on Crafting made easy and fun with my area of expertise - stamping, die-cutting, handmade CAS cards, scrapbooking and coloring pages.

feeds.title: K4 Craft Blog
feeds.description: K4 Craft is all about using crafts to improve your skills and broaden your thinking, as well as doing something new that identifies your personality. K4craft takes a holistic approach to develop skill and teaching everything about crafts, including simple decorations, jewelry, knitting, embroidery, paper crafts, quelling, and pottery, as well as basic lessons for novices.

feeds.title: Quillish
feeds.description: I'm Ishani, and I enjoy creating, especially card creation. Quilling brought me to cardmaking and I now like experimenting with other techniques for my cards. Cardmaking, quilling, paper crafting, general crafts, art and craft, craft for kids, and DIY are all covered on this blog.

feeds.title: Expressions Craft
feeds.description: Covers articles about Polymer Clear Stamps, Stencils, Handmade Paper Flowers, Chip Board Embellishments, Chalk Paints, Metallic Paints, Crackle paste, Gesso, Texture paste, Deco stones for mixed media Ink blending Tool, Ink blending Foam and Acrylic Blocks.

feeds.title: Al Things Beautiful
feeds.description: I'm Ann and this is my space where I'm taking the plunge in sharing my ideas and designs with you. I am working on creating more DIY art, crafts and sharing it on this platform.

feeds.title: Sweater Bunai By Sunayana Negi
feeds.description: My name is Sunaina Negi. I belong to Pauri Garhwal Uttarakhand and live in Dehradun city. This blog is related to knitting winter wear from wool such as socks, caps, shawls, sweaters, headbands, etc.

feeds.title: Periwinkle Creations
feeds.description: I am a wife & a mother of a wonderful son. Paper crafting is my way to Happiness! Blog posts cover articles on paper craft, Ink and Stamps.

feeds.title: Crafthues Blog
feeds.description: Crafthues is an amalgamation of two creative minds, who after graduating from design school and after spending some time in the fashion industry. Crafthues is a brand which displays our love for art on different products like Bags, cushion covers, hand-crafted jewelry and women's fashion accessories.

feeds.title: Artsy Craftsy Mom Blog
feeds.description: Shruti Bhat is a mother to a beautiful girl, an author, blogger, entrepreneur and occasional DIYer. On the Artsy Crafty Mom blog, Shruti shares ideas, information, and inspiration to encourage you to enjoy and share art & craft with the kids in your life including articles on kids art ideas, seasonal crafts and family fun activities.

feeds.title: HNDMD Blog
feeds.description: Learn art and craft tips and get inspired by artists across India and beyond. HNDMD aims at providing an entire range of craft supplies and art supplies viz. patterned papers, stamps, inks, embellishments, craft punches, art paints, crayons, markers, pens, and other art and craft supplies.
